# Synology Provider

Manage file shares, local accounts, permissions, and supported Synology DSM services over verified HTTPS.

Read and import were verified on DSM 7.1.1 on a DS220j. Check the [compatibility evidence by operation](https://github.com/elephant-evergreen/terraform-provider-synology/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md) for your NAS. Live writes remain experimental.

## Check the NAS connection

Set these environment variables before you run Terraform.

| Variable | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `SYNOLOGY_ENDPOINT` | Your DSM HTTPS origin, such as `https://nas.example.test:5001`. |
| `SYNOLOGY_USERNAME`, `SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD` | Your DSM account and password from your secret manager. |
| `SYNOLOGY_CA_FILE` | PEM bundle for your private certificate authority, if applicable. |
| `SYNOLOGY_OTP` | Current one-time code if your account requires it. |

Save this as `main.tf` in an empty directory.

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.17.1"

  required_providers {
    synology = {
      source  = "elephant-evergreen/synology"
      version = "~> 0.4.2"
    }
  }
}

provider "synology" {}

data "synology_network_interfaces" "nas" {}

output "interfaces" {
  value = sort(keys(data.synology_network_interfaces.nas.interfaces))
}
```

1. Run `terraform init`.
2. Run `terraform plan`. Look for interface names such as `eth0` in the planned `interfaces` output. This check reads DSM without an apply.

If certificate verification fails, check that the endpoint matches the certificate and that its issuing CA is trusted. If sign-in fails, check the account and refresh the one-time code if required.

## Adopt existing settings

Open the resource page for your share, user, or service and follow **Adopt existing settings**. For firewall policy, start with the [firewall resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs/resources/firewall#adopt-existing-settings).

Keep `.terraform.lock.hcl` in version control. Before upgrading, read the [release notes for your target version](https://github.com/elephant-evergreen/terraform-provider-synology/releases), then run `terraform init -upgrade` and review the lock file and plan.

## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Optional PEM certificate-authority bundle added to the system trust store. Falls back to SYNOLOGY_CA_FILE. Verification cannot be disabled.
- `endpoint` (String) DSM HTTPS origin, such as https://nas.example.test:5001. Falls back to SYNOLOGY_ENDPOINT. Certificate verification is mandatory.
- `otp` (String, Sensitive) Current one-time password, if required. Falls back to SYNOLOGY_OTP. Not a TOTP seed; never persisted by this provider.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Existing DSM password. Supports ephemeral values. Falls back with username to SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD; never mixed across credential sources.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Existing DSM account. Configure username and password together, or supply both SYNOLOGY_USERNAME and SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD.
